Implemented the fix in `src/bitops.c:975`: `BITPOS` now validates all range/unit arguments before checking whether the key exists, so missing keys can no longer mask syntax or integer errors.

Also verified the existing `BITCOUNT` argument validation order is correct. Ran `./runtest --single unit/bitops --clients 1`; all tests passed.
